name: data

name: toggleView
label: Show grid/list toggle
description: Select to show the toggle button that allows users to switch between grid and list view

name: defaultView
label: Default view
description: Default view choice between list and grid

name: cardHeight
label: Card height (grid view)

label: Min. card width (grid view)
description: Minimum card width 150 or greater pixels for grid view
